info.name: Marketplace API Reference Code Search API
Get information for a given code.

params.name: code
params.description: The code to find information for.

items.docs: Returns code data (code description and type of code) for a given code.

info.name: Gets a set of codes for given search criteria

params.name: term
params.description: Filter codes by the given term. The term is case-insensitive and can include the code.

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the number of records returned by the search.

items.docs: Returns codes for the given search term. When no term parameter is given, returns data for ALL codes.
